reviews.reason: Reviewed all eleven proof steps and the exact supplier conventions. Conjugation is a group isomorphism onto permutations of tensor positions, so the finite average is self-adjoint and idempotent with invariant range; counting strings gives the same normalized basis. The place sums have the stated adjoints and ladder coefficients, hence the spin-n/2 Casimir. Tensor telescoping gives operator-norm continuity and derivative -iJ_i on the whole finite space; n=0 is treated separately. Also made proof 3.3 restrict intermediate s_(k-1), s_(k+1) and binomial ratios to their valid ranges, deriving the two zero endpoints separately. No choice or empirical premise is used. This is an adjudicator review of its own repair, not independent certification.
